abilities.name: Slakoth lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little
it does not need much food. This Pokémon's sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
Slakoth's heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens
it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.
It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life
but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.
It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.
